approach-declared-runtime-dependencies.reason: Declaring runtime dependencies retires the zero-runtime-dependency identity that ADR-SDK-001, DEPENDENCIES.md, the dependency gate, and compatibility.json jointly enforce, widens the package trust boundary for every consumer, and forces compatibility.json and gate rewrites. Bundling keeps the ratified zero-runtime-dependency claim true and requires only generator, attribution, and package-gate work, which the recorded policy already enumerates.

security_justification.audit_integrity: No event construction, validation, emission, or ordering path changes; the record states a packaging policy and adjusts two verification-script constants.
security_justification.authentication_or_authorization: No authentication or authorization logic exists in or is touched by an ADR file and two literal constants in a coherence gate.
security_justification.authority_provenance: The authority branding registry in src/context.ts is untouched; no client claim or authoritative value changes representation.
security_justification.concurrency: No asynchronous, scheduling, or shared-state code changes; both touched files are read at build or verification time only.
security_justification.confidentiality: No data is read, transformed, stored, or transmitted; the ADR records a decision and cites already-public archived evidence.
security_justification.cryptography: No cryptographic primitive, key, hash, or signature path is introduced or modified by this decision record.
security_justification.error_disclosure: No error construction or message path changes; the coherence gate's failure text remains bounded to rule identifiers.
security_justification.external_security_integration: No SIEM, collector, exporter, or external security system is added; the authorization boundary is unchanged.
security_justification.fail_posture: The coherence gate keeps failing closed on an ADR count or sequence mismatch; the constant bump preserves exact-match semantics.
security_justification.lifecycle: No SDK lifecycle state, operation handle, or shutdown path changes; the record adds no runtime behavior at all.
security_justification.mutation_ownership: No ownership of any mutable structure moves; the ADR is a new immutable document and the gate edit replaces two literals.
security_justification.privacy_transformation: No field policy, redaction, or prohibited-data scanning behavior changes; no personal data path exists in either file.
security_justification.resource_retention: No buffer, queue, cache, or retention window is introduced; neither file allocates at SDK runtime.
security_justification.retry_or_redelivery: No delivery, retry, or redelivery semantics change; the sink interface and its in-flight tracking are untouched.
security_justification.trust_boundary: No runtime code, dependency surface, or public API changes; the record restates the existing zero-runtime-dependency trust boundary and the S-6 defect it was reconciled against.
